subject.description: Subject is a single-line summary of the issue.

description.description: Description is the detailed description of the issue.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Priority is the priority of a request as defined by the Octelium Support SLA.

idempotencyKey.description: IdempotencyKey is a unique key of the submission (e.g. a random UUID) that is reused when a submission is retried so that it does not open a duplicate request.

CreateSupportRequestRequest.title: Create Support Request Request
CreateSupportRequestRequest.description: CreateSupportRequestRequest is the request of the CreateSupportRequest method.
